title: Woo Ching Ying

page_data.en:
No
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
M. O. REG
No 242
Date 10/4/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
10th April 1916
Sir,
Four lighters laden with 3 inch field guns, and en route from Woosung to the Arsenal, passed the Bund at 11.15 a.m. 9th inst. It is said that these guns have been sent to General Yang in exchange for machine guns which he is sending to Woosung.
It is reported that a portion of the troops quartered in Woo Ching Ying (伍子營) camp mutinied at 1 a.m. 10th inst. The mutiny was quickly suppressed. The mutineers were disarmed and detained. It is said that a book was found in their possession which contained the names of soldiers who had enrolled as rebels. The Military Governor has ordered to have this matter kept very secret.
It is reported that Military Governor Lui will soon be promoted Chiangchun of Anwhui province. His troops who were under orders to proceed to Canton, will go to Nanking, and the upper Yangtsze instead.
It is reported that General Yang promised sometime ago to join the rebels. They have within the past few days requested him to carry out his promise, but he keeps putting them off from one day to another. They now believe that he has no intention of joining them, and they think the best cause is to assassinate him.
It is said that the warships in Shanghai will join the rebels as soon as the latter pay them $24,000.00. The rebels have offered the naval authorities $4,000.00 and military notes for the balance, but they will not accept it.
It is reported that the troops of the 13th and 14th regiments, who are under orders to leave Shanghai, have requested a bonus of 3 months pay for good work performed in protecting the Arsenal whilst here. It is said that they will refuse to leave here if their request is not granted.
Several parties of Japanese who passed through the Lunghwa district yesterday afternoon were searched by the Chinese soldiers, but nothing suspicious was found.
Your obedient servant,
（签名）
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
（批：Entered on M.S. Apl. 10.）
（批：H. 10/4.）

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）
M. O. 登记号
第 242 号
日期 1916年4月10日

致上海工部局。
1916年4月10日

先生：

四艘驳船装载着3英寸野战炮，于本月9日上午11时15分经过外滩，正从吴淞驶往兵工厂。据称，这些火炮是送给杨将军的，用以交换他正运往吴淞的机枪。

据报道，驻扎在伍子营（Woo Ching Ying）军营的部分部队于本月10日凌晨1时发生兵变。兵变很快被镇压。叛变士兵被解除武装并予以拘留。据说在他们身上发现了一本名册，其中列有已加入叛军行列的士兵姓名。督军已下令对此事严加保密。

据报道，吕督军不久将升任安徽省长。其部队原奉命前往广东，现改为前往南京及长江上游地区。

据报道，杨将军此前曾许诺加入叛军。过去几天内，叛军一直要求他履行诺言，但他却日复一日地推脱。他们现在认为他无意加入，并认为最好的办法是刺杀他。

据称，一旦叛军支付24,000.00美元，驻上海的军舰便会加入叛军。叛军已向海军当局提供4,000.00美元及余额部分的军用票据，但海军方面拒绝接受。

据报道，奉命离开上海的第13和第14团士兵要求发放三个月薪饷作为奖金，以表彰他们在此期间履行保护兵工厂职责的良好表现。据称，如果这一要求得不到满足，他们将拒绝离开此地。

昨日下午，几批途经龙华地区的日本人遭到中国士兵搜查，但未发现任何可疑物品。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
首席侦探督察长。
警务处总监。
（批注：已于4月10日录入M.S.。）
（批注：H. 10/4.）
